text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Dober in the lead, Dober in the lead! It's 
Dober out in front!!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Across the line!! In this battle between 
the Mejiro family, victory goes to Dober!!
(WAAAAAH!)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Haaah, haaah, haaah...!!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: ...Splendidly done~, Dober.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Bright... Th-Thank you.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, please don't look so bewildered, 
stand tall and be proud~.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
The Tenno Sho shield holds a special 
meaning for us Mejiros.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
So please, hold your head high and be 
proud—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Bright...?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: I'm so sorry.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Ah, Bright—!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: Ugh... Urgh—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: Uuuuuuuugh...!!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
I shouldn't have given in...! Out of all 
moments... this was the one time I 
couldn't afford to yield!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
“How pathetic of me! Once again, I've 
ended up burdening Dober with 
everything...!”

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: No, I cannot let it end like this.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: I will. I shall be the one to achieve it.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Lady McQueen, and Ryan-onesama too. 
Surpassing every brilliant light the 
Mejiro family has built until now—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Our "new glory"... Together with Dober, I 
will—!!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
…………――Looks like I need to retrain myself 
from scratch~.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Bright...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
(Her... the aura surrounding her has 
changed. Strong, majestic, just like—yes, 
just like Air Groove-senpai...)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: ...Amazing. How can I be more like Bright—

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Mejiro Dober. What you desire, the future 
you strive for, that glory... You will 
never reach it as you are now.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Those belong to none other than—

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Because if I'm not "Mejiro Dober," it's 
something I'll never be able to attain.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Huh? ...Wait, since when did I—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Since when did you start trying to become 
"someone else"?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Since when... did you start thinking that 
simply seizing the same glory as "someone 
else" was enough—?

...On the way back from Kyoto Racecourse, 
Mejiro Dober hadn't said a single word—

Only after reaching the trainer's office 
did those tightly shut lips finally open.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: ...I finally get it now.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
What you were trying to say after the 
Osaka Hai. What Air Groove-senpai said.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
What Trainer was trying to say after the 
Osaka Hai. What Air Groove-senpai said.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
"Why can't I be like Senpai... like 
Bright, or the other Mejiro girls?"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
"Because you're trying to become like 
everyone else," —right?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
"‘Someday, the glory that Ramonu-san 
envisioned... I want to carry it on, 
too.’"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Aiming for the Triple Tiara, just so I 
could become like Ms. Ramonu.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
"‘If I can follow the path you took... 
catch up to where you are... and become 
just like you, Senpai—’"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
I set my Senior Year rotation, striving to 
become like Air Groove-senpai.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
So today, I was thinking about how I'd 
like to be more like Bright.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: ...Even though that's not how it is.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
McQueen, Ryan... Bright, Air 
Groove-senpai, everyone—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
By my own power, on my own path, in my own 
way! Because I'm resolved to make myself 
shine! ...She's strong, and yet...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: I just... lacked confidence.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
"I didn't have the resolve to shine on my 
own! That's why... I just chased after 
everyone, hoping to bask in their light—"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
At this rate... it's no good. I won't be 
able to seize a "new glory for Mejiro" 
like this.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: I'm... still so weak...!!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: It's fine!!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
"...Thanks for always telling me that. I 
get it. I know how you feel."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
"...Thanks for always telling me that. I 
get it. Trainer, I know how you feel."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
"Still, that's why... I want to face it 
now. I have to face it."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
To what I've always lost to. To my own 
slyness—my own weakness.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
"...Even so, you'll still believe in me, 
won't you?"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
"...Even so, Trainer, you'll still believe 
in me, right?"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
I know... that I can overcome even my own 
weaknesses.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
You think of me as... that strong of an 
Umamusume, don't you...?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Yeah. ...I thought you'd say that.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: —I'm running in the Takarazuka Kinen.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
But it's not because I'm chasing after Air 
Groove-senpai. It's not because I want to 
be like someone else.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: To conquer my weak self.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: To become the truly strong me... I'll run.
